headline: New research reveals surprising link in ocean carbon cycle: swimming sea cucumbers
summary: In a new publication in the scientific journal Ecology, Senior Scientist Bruce Robison reports how the swimming sea cucumber Pelagothuria natatrix interrupts the transport of carbon to the abyssal seafloor in the Galápagos Islands, highlighting the important role of marine life…
imageAlt: A translucent pink sea cucumber opens its webbed feeding tentacles while drifting in open blue water.
